description: Last 14 days of 30-minute steps: new radar stories per step (flow) against the mean absolute change of the 8 radar levels. Verdicts collecting, dulled_under_flow, same_under_flow, sharper_under_flow, with the ratio of response at top-10% flow to the rest and a daily table. A link between two series, not a cause and not human attention; flow follows the time of day. Rule-based, no AI. In honour of Georg Simmel (1858-1918), author of 'The Metropolis and Mental Life'.
name: get_simmel
title: Simmel sensor: do radar indices move less when the flow of new stories is heavy
